title: 21. Projects: Real-Time Chat Application
objectives: Build the Real-Time Chat Application projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: What You'll Build
sections.body:
A production real-time messaging system:

- 1-on-1 and group chat rooms
- WebSocket for instant messaging
- Typing indicators ("John is typing...")
- Online/offline presence
- Message read receipts
- File/image sharing
- Message search
- Push notifications

sections.title: Architecture
sections.body:
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Clients                                │
│  WebSocket connections (persistent)                         │
└──────────┬──────────────┬──────────────┬───────────────────┘
           │              │              │
┌──────────▼──────────────▼──────────────▼───────────────────┐
│              WebSocket Load Balancer                         │
│         (Nginx with sticky sessions)                        │
└──────────┬──────────────┬──────────────┬───────────────────┘
           │              │              │
    ┌──────▼─────┐ ┌──────▼─────┐ ┌─────▼──────┐
    │ WS Server  │ │ WS Server  │ │ WS Server  │
    │ Instance 1 │ │ Instance 2 │ │ Instance 3 │
    └──────┬─────┘ └──────┬─────┘ └─────┬──────┘
           │              │              │
    ┌──────▼──────────────▼──────────────▼──────┐
    │         Redis Pub/Sub                      │
    │   (Cross-server message routing)           │
    └──────┬──────────────┬─────────────────────┘
           │              │
    ┌──────▼─────┐ ┌──────▼──────────────────┐
    │  MongoDB   │ │  Redis                   │
    │ (Messages, │ │ (Online users, Presence, │
    │  Rooms)    │ │  Typing indicators)      │
    └────────────┘ └──────────────────────────┘
```

### Key Scaling Challenge: WebSocket Across Multiple Servers

```
Problem:
  User A connected to Server 1
  User B connected to Server 2
  A sends message to B → Server 1 doesn't know about B!

Solution: Redis Pub/Sub (message bus between servers)
  Server 1 → publishes "new message" to Redis channel
  Redis → broadcasts to ALL subscribed servers
  Server 2 → receives → sends to User B via WebSocket
```

sections.title: Key Implementations
sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- Manages WebSocket connections with Redis Pub/Sub for multi-server support
- Send message to room via Redis Pub/Sub (reaches ALL servers)
- Publish event to Redis Pub/Sub channel
- Background task: Listen for Redis messages and forward to local WebSockets
- Local connections on THIS server
- Room_id → {user_id: websocket}
- Subscribe to Redis channel for this room
- Publish to Redis (all servers will receive)

**Defines:** `ChatManager`, `websocket_chat()`, `MessageService`

### WebSocket Manager with Redis Pub/Sub

```python
# app/services/chat_manager.py
import redis.asyncio as redis
from fastapi import WebSocket
import json, asyncio

class ChatManager:
    """Manages WebSocket connections with Redis Pub/Sub for multi-server support"""

    def __init__(self, redis_url: str):
        self.redis = redis.from_url(redis_url)
        self.pubsub = self.redis.pubsub()
        # Local connections on THIS server
        self.local_connections: dict[str, dict[int, WebSocket]] = {}
        # room_id → {user_id: websocket}

    async def connect(self, user_id: int, room_id: str, websocket: WebSocket):
        await websocket.accept()

        if room_id not in self.local_connections:
            self.local_connections[room_id] = {}
            # Subscribe to Redis channel for this room
            await self.pubsub.subscribe(f"room:{room_id}")

        self.local_connections[room_id][user_id] = websocket

        # Update user presence
        await self.redis.sadd(f"room:{room_id}:online", user_id)
        await self.redis.set(f"user:{user_id}:status", "online")

        # Notify room
        await self.publish_event(room_id, {
            "type": "user_joined",
            "user_id": user_id,
            "online_users": await self.get_online_users(room_id)
        })

    async def disconnect(self, user_id: int, room_id: str):
        if room_id in self.local_connections:
            self.local_connections[room_id].pop(user_id, None)

        await self.redis.srem(f"room:{room_id}:online", user_id)
        await self.redis.set(f"user:{user_id}:status", "offline")
        await self.redis.set(f"user:{user_id}:last_seen", datetime.utcnow().isoformat())

        await self.publish_event(room_id, {
            "type": "user_left",
            "user_id": user_id
        })

    async def send_message(self, room_id: str, user_id: int, content: str, msg_type: str = "text"):
        """Send message to room via Redis Pub/Sub (reaches ALL servers)"""
        message = {
            "type": "message",
            "room_id": room_id,
            "user_id": user_id,
            "content": content,
            "msg_type": msg_type,
            "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
            "id": str(ObjectId()),
        }

        # Save to MongoDB
        await self.save_message(message)

        # Publish to Redis (all servers will receive)
        await self.publish_event(room_id, message)

    async def publish_event(self, room_id: str, event: dict):
        """Publish event to Redis Pub/Sub channel"""
        await self.redis.publish(f"room:{room_id}", json.dumps(event))

    async def listen_redis(self):
        """Background task: Listen for Redis messages and forward to local WebSockets"""
        async for message in self.pubsub.listen():
            if message["type"] == "message":
                data = json.loads(message["data"])
                room_id = data.get("room_id")

                # Forward to local WebSocket connections
                if room_id in self.local_connections:
                    for user_id, ws in list(self.local_connections[room_id].items()):
                        try:
                            await ws.send_json(data)
                        except:
                            await self.disconnect(user_id, room_id)

    async def set_typing(self, room_id: str, user_id: int, is_typing: bool):
        """Typing indicator"""
        if is_typing:
            await self.redis.setex(f"typing:{room_id}:{user_id}", 5, "1")  # Expires in 5s
        else:
            await self.redis.delete(f"typing:{room_id}:{user_id}")

        await self.publish_event(room_id, {
            "type": "typing",
            "user_id": user_id,
            "is_typing": is_typing
        })

    async def get_online_users(self, room_id: str) -> list:
        return [int(uid) for uid in await self.redis.smembers(f"room:{room_id}:online")]
```

### WebSocket Endpoint

```python
# app/api/chat_ws.py
@app.websocket("/ws/chat/{room_id}")
async def websocket_chat(websocket: WebSocket, room_id: str):
    # Authenticate
    token = websocket.query_params.get("token")
    user = verify_token(token)

    await chat_manager.connect(user.id, room_id, websocket)

    try:
        while True:
            data = await websocket.receive_json()

            match data["type"]:
                case "message":
                    await chat_manager.send_message(
                        room_id, user.id, data["content"]
                    )

                case "typing":
                    await chat_manager.set_typing(
                        room_id, user.id, data["is_typing"]
                    )

                case "read_receipt":
                    await chat_manager.mark_read(
                        room_id, user.id, data["message_id"]
                    )

    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        await chat_manager.disconnect(user.id, room_id)
```

### Message Persistence (MongoDB)

```python
# app/services/message_service.py
class MessageService:
    async def save_message(self, message: dict):
        await self.db.messages.insert_one(message)

    async def get_room_history(self, room_id: str, before: str = None, limit: int = 50):
        """Paginated message history (load older messages on scroll up)"""
        query = {"room_id": room_id}
        if before:
            query["timestamp"] = {"$lt": before}

        cursor = self.db.messages.find(query).sort("timestamp", -1).limit(limit)
        messages = await cursor.to_list(length=limit)
        messages.reverse()  # Chronological order
        return messages

    async def search_messages(self, room_id: str, query: str):
        """Full-text search in chat history"""
        return await self.db.messages.find({
            "room_id": room_id,
            "$text": {"$search": query}
        }).sort("timestamp", -1).limit(20).to_list(length=20)
```
